column1: # ARM header validation, address/layout resolution and fixed instruction forms.
# Image constants/imports and word output are live bindings; memorylayout remains shared.
# Headers precede instructions; sizing-pass declarations must be unique except symbol entries.
# Target declarations select Linux, macOS or Windows address layout.
# Named data addresses are nonnegative 31-bit values and symbols are unique.
# File layout uses current image constants; memorylayout may subsequently bind actual bases.
# Windows imports and standard handles use the current import index and bound instruction words.
# Address and memory forms share AD.data adjustment and ADRP generation.
# Resolve declared data symbols before code labels on the emitting pass.
# Emit exactly two words; page displacement must fit signed 21 bits.
# Argument save/get operations share the same bound data-address path.
# Parse @data_len while scanning headers, before either code pass.
